faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Jammu Project Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the Project Assistant position at IIT Jammu is 22nd September 2026. It is advisable to submit your application well before this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have a B.Tech/B.E. or M.Sc. in Civil/Environmental Engineering/Biotechnology/Environmental Science or a relevant discipline with a minimum of 60% marks or 6.5 CGPA. An M.Tech/M.E. is also acceptable.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Assistant position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Assistant post is 28 years. There are provisions for age relaxation for certain categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Assistant role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Assistant position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 25,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Assistant position at IIT Jammu.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the IIT Jammu Project Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process typically involves shortlisting of eligible candidates followed by an interview. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for specific details.

faq.question: Q8. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: The job is on a contractual basis for the Project Assistant position at IIT Jammu.

faq.question: Q9. Where is IIT Jammu located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Jammu is located in Jammu, Jammu and Kashmir.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from outside Jammu and Kashmir apply?
faq.answer: The notification mentions inviting applications from eligible candidates in Jammu and Kashmir. However, it is always best to refer to the official notification for precise eligibility details regarding domicile requirements.
